explain.zh: 药品专利链接制度（2020 年修改新增）。仿制药申请人和专利权人可以向法院起诉，请求确认申请注册的药品技术方案是否落入专利保护范围；也可以向国家知识产权局请求行政裁决。

explain.en: Under the Implementing Measures (NMPA/CNIPA Announcement No. 89 of 2021), the patentee must sue or seek adjudication within 45 days after the drug evaluation centre publishes the application following a Category 4 certification, and a nine-month stay applies to chemical generics.
explain.zh: 配套规定《药品专利纠纷早期解决机制实施办法（试行）》（国家药监局、国家知识产权局 2021 年第 89 号公告）：专利权人收到四类声明后，须在药品审评机构公开上市申请之日起 45 日内起诉或请求裁决；药监部门对化学仿制药设置 9 个月等待期。

explain.en: Compared with Hatch-Waxman: also 45 days, but counted from receipt of the Paragraph IV notice, and a 30-month stay in the US (21 U.S.C. §355(j)(5)(B)(iii)), and filing an ANDA is itself an artificial act of infringement (35 U.S.C. §271(e)(2)); the Chinese linkage action seeks a declaration on scope rather than infringement relief.
explain.zh: 对比美国 Hatch-Waxman：起诉期都是 45 日，但起算点不同（美国从专利权人收到第四段声明通知之日起算），美国的等待期是 30 个月（21 U.S.C. §355(j)(5)(B)(iii)），而且提交 ANDA 本身就被拟制为侵权（35 U.S.C. §271(e)(2)）。中国的链接诉讼是“确认是否落入保护范围”之诉，不是侵权之诉。

units.label: 第七十七条
units.group: 第七章 专利权的保护
units.groupEn: Chapter VII Protection of Patent Rights

paras.en: Any person who, for production and business purposes, uses, offers to sell or sells a patent-infringing product, without knowing that it is manufactured and sold without the authorization of the patentee, may not be liable for compensation provided that he can prove the legitimate source of the product.
paras.zh: 为生产经营目的使用、许诺销售或者销售不知道是未经专利权人许可而制造并售出的专利侵权产品，能证明该产品合法来源的，不承担赔偿责任。

units.label: 第七十八条
units.group: 第七章 专利权的保护
units.groupEn: Chapter VII Protection of Patent Rights

paras.en: Where any person, in violation of the provisions of Article 19 of this Law, files a patent application in a foreign country, thereby divulging a State secret, the entity to which he belongs or the competent authority at the higher level shall impose on him an administrative sanction; if a crime is established, he shall be investigated for his criminal responsibility in accordance with law.
paras.zh: 违反本法第十九条规定向外国申请专利，泄露国家秘密的，由所在单位或者上级主管机关给予行政处分；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。

units.label: 第七十九条
units.group: 第七章 专利权的保护
units.groupEn: Chapter VII Protection of Patent Rights

paras.en: The departments in charge of patent-related work under the people's governments may not take part in recommending any patented product for sale to the public or any such commercial activities.
paras.zh: 管理专利工作的部门不得参与向社会推荐专利产品等经营活动。

paras.en: Where a department in charge of patent-related work under the people's governments violates the provisions of the preceding paragraph, it shall be ordered to make a rectification and to eliminate adverse effects by the department at the higher level or the supervisory organ. The illegal earnings, if any, shall be confiscated. Where the circumstances are serious, the principal leading person directly in charge and other persons who are directly responsible shall be given sanctions in accordance with the law.
paras.zh: 管理专利工作的部门违反前款规定的，由其上级机关或者监察机关责令改正，消除影响，有违法收入的予以没收；情节严重的，对直接负责的主管人员和其他直接责任人员依法给予处分。

units.label: 第八十条
units.group: 第七章 专利权的保护
units.groupEn: Chapter VII Protection of Patent Rights

paras.en: Where a State functionary working for patent administration or any other State functionary concerned neglects his duties, abuses his powers, or engages in malpractice for personal gain, which constitutes a crime, shall be investigated for his criminal responsibility in accordance with law. If the case is not serious enough to constitute a crime, he shall be given sanctions in accordance with law.
paras.zh: 从事专利管理工作的国家机关工作人员以及其他有关国家机关工作人员玩忽职守、滥用职权、徇私舞弊，构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任；尚不构成犯罪的，依法给予处分。

units.label: 第八十一条
units.group: 第八章 附则
units.groupEn: Chapter VIII Supplementary Provisions

paras.en: To file a patent application or go through other formalities with the patent administrative department under the State Council, fees shall be paid as prescribed.
paras.zh: 向国务院专利行政部门申请专利和办理其他手续，应当按照规定缴纳费用。

units.label: 第八十二条
units.group: 第八章 附则
units.groupEn: Chapter VIII Supplementary Provisions

paras.en: This Law shall go into effect on 1 April 1985.
paras.zh: 本法自1985年4月1日起施行。

units.label: 实施办法第七条
units.group: 药品专利纠纷早期解决机制实施办法（试行）
units.groupEn: Implementing Measures for the Early Resolution Mechanism for Drug Patent Disputes (Trial)

paras.en: Where the patentee or an interested party objects to a Category 4 patent certification, it may, within 45 days from the date on which the national drug evaluation institution publishes the application for drug marketing authorisation, file a lawsuit with the people's court, or request administrative adjudication from the patent administration department under the State Council, on whether the relevant technical solution of the drug applied for marketing falls within the scope of protection of the relevant patent right. A party dissatisfied with the administrative adjudication made by the patent administration department under the State Council may sue in the people's court in accordance with law after receiving the written adjudication.
paras.zh: 专利权人或者利害关系人对四类专利声明有异议的，可以自国家药品审评机构公开药品上市许可申请之日起45日内，就申请上市药品的相关技术方案是否落入相关专利权保护范围向人民法院提起诉讼或者向国务院专利行政部门请求行政裁决。当事人对国务院专利行政部门作出的行政裁决不服的，可以在收到行政裁决书后依法向人民法院起诉。

units.label: 实施办法第八条
units.group: 药品专利纠纷早期解决机制实施办法（试行）
units.groupEn: Implementing Measures for the Early Resolution Mechanism for Drug Patent Disputes (Trial)

paras.en: After receiving a copy of the case acceptance notice of the people's court or of the acceptance notice of the patent administration department under the State Council, the drug regulatory department under the State Council shall set a nine-month waiting period for the registration application of the chemical generic drug. The waiting period runs from the date of acceptance by the people's court or by the patent administration department under the State Council and is set only once. The national drug evaluation institution does not stop the technical evaluation during the waiting period.
paras.zh: 收到人民法院立案或者国务院专利行政部门受理通知书副本后，国务院药品监督管理部门对化学仿制药注册申请设置9个月的等待期。等待期自人民法院立案或者国务院专利行政部门受理之日起，只设置一次。等待期内国家药品审评机构不停止技术审评。
